info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Partner Authentication Management API
info.description: The Partner Authentication Management API enables businesses to manage authentication processes for partner integrations effectively. This endpoint allows for updating authentication details related to partner accounts, ensuring secure and streamlined access. Common use cases include managing access permissions and updating credentials for partner applications. This API serves developers involved in enhancing partner collaboration while maintaining security standards.

put.description: This endpoint allows clients to update the authentication details of a partner. Ensure that you include the necessary credentials and parameters to successfully modify the partner's authentication information.

requestBody.description: Request body for authenticating a partner. This should include the necessary credentials for the authentication process, formatted as JSON.

204.description: Authentication request processed successfully with no response body.

partnerSecret.description: The current secret associated with the partner.

newPartnerSecret.description: The new secret to be set for the partner.

immediate.description: Indicates whether the update should be performed immediately.
